cohort: 247 mother-neonate pairs, infants born between 24(+0) and 31(+6) weeks of gestation
finding: Early-onset preeclampsia is associated with the development of BPD in very preterm neonates, with part of this association mediated by fetal growth restriction and mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery partially mediates the association between preeclampsia and BPD in very preterm infants.
